gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian moves with loose, rope-like curves that never knot. Bellota Text is best at commanding shapes with no calligraphic shading, while the sans body is best at contemporary, clean running text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ojuju: Ojuju reads approachable, with wide s curves barely curled in and a touch heavier than the joins. But Bellota Text is the standout, with commanding letters that carry no thick-thin shift at all.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-overpass: Bellota Text draws commanding letters with no calligraphic shading and open, distinctive curves everywhere. Overpass stays modern and professional, its bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mixing within a single word.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-palanquin: Palanquin reads contemporary and sturdy, its curved letters keeping wide, unclosed mouths that let each word breathe. Bellota Text earns its keep big and short, joints never thinning or bulging.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-philosopher: Bellota Text keeps one stroke thickness everywhere, with open shapes and a commanding, distinctive presence. Philosopher adds a slight pressure shadow, like worn charcoal, and that quiet shift is the best thing here.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans reads approachable, with c forms that sweep as open arcs against the constant stroke width of Bellota Text. Size the body up a notch and its openness really shows.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-quattrocento-sans: Bellota Text is commanding, with strokes free of contrast from stem to terminal. Quattrocento Sans keeps clear gaps so its c never closes into an o, and paragraphs glide by with a modern, clean feel.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-reddit-sans: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota Text draws its letters with open shapes and no calligraphic shading. Reddit Sans settles in behind it, its e wide at the terminal and its strokes steady in every direction, so reading flows.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-rosario: Approachable and contemporary, Rosario keeps the ends of its c from ever turning inward, so letters stay open. Bellota Text is best at commanding, single-width impact; Rosario at quiet reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ruluko: Bellota Text gives its diagonals the full weight of its verticals for a commanding, distinctive look. And Ruluko, approachable and clean, spreads broad open counters on c and s, so extended reading stays easy.
